sceneCreate.title: Create a new scene
sceneCreate.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the scene, the key events, the NPCs present...

sceneEdit.subtitle: Scene
sceneEdit.aiAssistantTitle: Open the AI Assistant to discuss this scene
sceneEdit.illustrationsHint: NPC portraits, visual mood, evocative scenes...
sceneEdit.battlemapHint: Battle map to export to Foundry: media (image/video) + Universal VTT .json/.dd2vtt file (Dungeon Alchemist, Dungeondraft...). Not displayed in the app.
sceneEdit.descriptionPlaceholder: One or two sentences summarizing what happens...
sceneEdit.atmospherePlaceholder: Describe the general atmosphere of the scene (sounds, smells, light, emotions...)
sceneEdit.narrationPlaceholder: The text you will read to the players to set the scene...
sceneEdit.narrationHint: This text can be read directly to your players.
sceneEdit.gmNotesPlaceholder: Hidden information, clues, secret elements the players must not know...
sceneEdit.gmNotesHint: These notes are private and visible only to the GM.
sceneEdit.choicesPlaceholder: Describe the different options available to the players and their consequences...
sceneEdit.branchesNoSibling: 💡 You need at least one other scene in this chapter to create branches. Create other scenes first, then come back here to connect them.
sceneEdit.branchLabelPlaceholder: E.g.: If the players attack the guard
sceneEdit.branchesHint: Each branch represents a possible "exit" from this scene depending on the players' action. Targets are limited to scenes in the same chapter.
sceneEdit.bestiaryEnemiesHint: Reference sheets from your bestiary — click a chip to open the sheet.
sceneEdit.enemiesPlaceholder: List of enemies present in this scene...
sceneEdit.loreHint: Pin the location, NPCs or creatures of this scene here. Click a chip to open the page.
sceneEdit.noLoreHint: 💡 This campaign is not associated with any universe. Associate it with a Lore on the campaign screen to be able to pin Lore pages to this scene.
sceneEdit.dungeonHint: If this scene represents a location to explore room by room, add them here. The scene then switches to "dungeon" mode in the display.
sceneEdit.chatWelcome: I can see this scene. Ask me to enrich its mood, its narration or its choices.
sceneEdit.chatSuggestion1: Suggest an immersive sensory atmosphere for this scene
sceneEdit.chatSuggestion2: Suggest an opening narration to read to the players
sceneEdit.chatSuggestion3: Come up with 2 choices with striking consequences
